title: Existence and positive Hölder minimizers for the two-phase Robin free-boundary energy with uniformly positive exterior Sobolev data
author: Serena Guarino Lo Bianco; Domenico Angelo La Manna; Bozhidar Velichkov
work: A two-phase problem with Robin conditions on the free boundary
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.139
difficulty_reason: Ordinary finite-perimeter compactness does not give a perimeter bound when the Robin boundary weight can approach zero. The author constructs positive-floor approximating minimisers, proves uniform interior Hölder bounds, and passes a carefully chosen optimality condition to the limit. A nonlinear coarea/isoperimetric iteration then forces a positive lower bound, which supplies the missing perimeter compactness and completes the minimiser construction.
